description.content:
Returns retailer-specific wholesale prices for a batch of product variants.
Prices are computed with all applicable discounts applied (AKS+, segment,
business-event discounts), so `wholesale_price` reflects the actual price
the authenticated retailer would pay.

Both the original (pre-discount) and the effective (post-discount) wholesale
prices are returned so callers can display strikethrough pricing when a
discount applies.

Variants not found or not priceable for the authenticated retailer are
silently omitted from the response.

query.description:
(Required) One or more product variant UUIDs to price. Repeat the parameter for
each UUID. Minimum 1, maximum 50 per request.
